# Workspace Instructions

## Project

Responsive, dependency-free portfolio for Ella Khanya Mpu using semantic HTML, CSS, and vanilla JavaScript. Open `index.html` directly; no build or development server is required.

## Setup Checklist

- [x] Verify workspace instructions file. Summary: present in `.github`.
- [x] Clarify requirements. Summary: responsive vanilla portfolio with Pixel Bloom styling and accessible interactions.
- [x] Scaffold project. Summary: created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `app.js` in the workspace root.
- [x] Customize project. Summary: implemented profile, journey, projects, certificates, contact, and Cutie assistant.
- [x] Install extensions. Summary: none required.
- [x] Compile project. Summary: no build step; VS Code diagnostics report no errors.
- [x] Create and run task. Summary: not needed for a directly openable static site.
- [x] Launch project. Summary: preview via `index.html`; no debug session or server required.
- [x] Complete documentation. Summary: `README.md` documents launch and configuration.

## Content and Configuration

- Keep personal, education, training, and project claims grounded in information supplied by Ella.
- Keep project, skill, and certificate records in `portfolioData` in `app.js`; render changes through the existing page templates.
- Do not invent project URLs, a GitHub username, Formspree endpoint, CV file, certificate files, project details, technologies, or certificate metadata.
- Configure GitHub username and Formspree endpoint in `CONFIG` in `app.js` before enabling those services.
- Add certificate and course records with only confirmed metadata; keep the accessible preview modal and category filters working.
- Preserve the confirmed email and LinkedIn links in the Contact section.
- Preserve keyboard accessibility, visible focus, reduced-motion support, responsive layouts, and the persistent dark mode toggle.
